  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    hec.event.AbstractDataListener, hec.event.DataChangeListener, hec.event.LockListener, AsciiSerializable, DBFSerializable, FieldAccessor, DataObject, DataStruct, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.lang.Comparable, java.util.EventListener, java.util.Observer, rma.lang.Modifiable

    public class ModifiedTime
extends AbstractDBFObject

    Title: CWMS Development

    Description: This is a simple class that will store the modification time for an object, particularly a DBF file. The standard DBF Header only allows for day granularity when we need second granularity. This file baiscally holds a fileName and a modification time in miliseconds.

    Copyright: Copyright (c) 2002

    Company: Resource Management Associates
